title: Simplify Implant Depth Prediction as Video Grounding: A Texture Perceive Implant Depth Prediction Network

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding

evidence.quote: Inspired by the video grounding task which localizes the starting and ending time of the target video segment, in this paper, we simplify the implant depth prediction as video grounding and develop a Texture Perceive Implant Depth Prediction Network (TPNet), which enables us to directly output the implant depth without complex measurements of oral bone.
